summary: Decomposes a target vehicle velocity into longitudinal and lateral components relative to the direction vector (a2, a4). Loads the target velocity via the this[0] indirection pointer (obj+0x34F8, obj+0x3500), computes a projection factor against the squared direction norm (guarded on zero), writes the signed longitudinal magnitude minus offset a5 into this[6] and the signed perpendicular magnitude into this[4]. Called every frame from AISteering (004270a0).

local_names.this: steering/relative-vector accumulator; this[4] lateral component, this[6] longitudinal component

operations.description: Load target velocity through the this[0] indirection: vx from obj+0x34F8 and vy from obj+0x3500
v19 = a4*a4 + a2*a2, the squared norm of the direction vector used as the projection denominator
If v19 == 0.0 the projection factor v7 is forced to 0.0; otherwise v7 = (a4*vy + a2*vx) / v19 (normalized dot product)
Longitudinal result: build v20=a2*v7, v22=a4*v7, take the signed sqrt of (v22*v22 + v20*v20) (sign from compare flags), store into this[6], then subtract a5 from this[6]
Lateral result: v13 = (a2*vy - a4*vx) / v19 (cross term), then v21=-a4*v13, v23=a2*v13, store the sign-inverted sqrt of (v23*v23 + v21*v21) into this[4]
